title: CE60116: Experimental Stress Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Advanced concept of Stress and Strain, Different measures of Stress and Strain
and relations between them, Application of stress and strain to various
experimental problems, Photoelasticity concept and application to problems,
